content.text: {"hypothesis":"The prior negative move_x bias probe worsened validation movement MSE and active-movement MSE. A smaller positive bias adjustment tests the opposite local direction while limiting low-urgency drift. Changing only the movement output bias preserves hazard exactly, and the tanh Lipschitz bound limits movement drift MSE to 0.0000005 per input. This is a conservative validation-informed correction, not an identified urgency-dependent avoidance mechanism.","edits":[{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"delta":0.001}]}
